items.title: CVS announces plan to split into 2 companies
items.summary: CVS (CVS) plans to spin off roughly 9,000 retail pharmacies into a separate publicly traded company by the first half of 2028.

items.title: 1 of the Largest Corporate Splits in History Is Coming to Wall Street in 2028 -- It's a Stock Up 737% Since Its IPO

items.title: Mark Cuban Says the CVS Breakup Is ‘Great for Shareholders.’ Here’s What It Means for a 67-Year-Old Who Bought 1,000 Shares the Day the Aetna Deal Closed
items.summary: Mark Cuban wrote on X that CVS Health's planned 2028 breakup is "great for shareholders" and "changes nothing for patients." On the day it was announced the stock fell 12.5%, about $15 billion of market value. For a retiree holding 1,000 shares since the 2018 Aetna deal, here is what the split does to the position, the $2,660-a-year dividend and the cost basis, and the three numbers CVS has not published yet.

items.title: The top 5 analyst questions from CVS Health’s Q3 2026 earnings call
items.summary: CVS Health’s latest quarter saw the company deliver revenue and profit above Wall Street’s expectations, but the market responded negatively. Management pointed to consistent gains in its core segments, driven by pharmacy strength and progress in Medicare margin recovery. CEO David Joyner highlighted the quarter as "another demonstration of disciplined execution," emphasizing ongoing improvement in the company’s medical benefit ratio and strong cash flow generation.

items.title: Medicare Just Locked In Most of Your 2027 Costs. One Big Number Is Still Missing
items.summary: Medicare open enrollment ends Dec. 7, and most 2027 costs are set: a $2,400 Part D cap, a $700 deductible and a 3.6% COLA. For a 72-year-old with one costly drug, the bill rises $300, her check nets about $76 more a month, and a plan comparison is worth $408.
